name: Shared Light: Lynn Goldsmith at Selby Gardens
venue: Marie Selby Botanical Gardens, Downtown Sarasota Campus
hours_label: Daily 10 AM - 5 PM · $28 adults, $12 ages 5-17, under 4 free
blurb: Last week to see Selby Gardens' indoor and outdoor exhibition of Lynn Goldsmith, the celebrated rock-and-roll and nature photographer whose portraits of Patti Smith, Bruce Springsteen and others hang in the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame. Admission includes the bayfront gardens, conservatory and Michael's on the Bay. $28 adults, $12 ages 5-17, members free.
photo_credit: Photo: Marie Selby Botanical Gardens / Selby.org

name: Summon the Heroes: 9/11 25th Anniversary Benefit Concert
blurb: Sarasota Orchestra and the Van Wezel mark 25 years since September 11 with a one-night benefit: Copland's Fanfare for the Common Man, Barber's Adagio for Strings and John Williams' Summon the Heroes, with narration by Nate Jacobs and soprano Amy Owens singing Amazing Grace and America the Beautiful. Tickets are $25 to $50 with fees waived; proceeds support Resilient Retreat, the Sarasota County Sheriff's Office Charitable Foundation, the Sarasota Firefighters Benevolent Fund and the Sarasota Police Foundation.
source: Van Wezel / Sarasota Orchestra / Your Observer

name: 9/11 Memorial Stair Climb and Day of Remembrance
blurb: On the 25th anniversary of September 11, the community gathers at the Finish Tower to walk, climb or run its stairs in remembrance; 17 summits equals the 110 stories of the World Trade Center towers. Area firefighters climb in full gear, with an honor guard and a ladder truck flying the flag. Free and open to all ages; online registration is requested.

name: Sarasota Farmers Market
venue: Downtown Sarasota, Lemon Ave & Main St
blurb: Sarasota's original Saturday ritual since 1979: 70-plus vendors along Lemon Avenue and Main Street with local produce, fresh seafood, baked goods, orchids, coffee and live music. Dog-friendly and walkable to the bayfront. Free to attend, rain or shine.
source: Sarasota Farmers Market / evergreen weekly anchor
